industry_relative_return_20.name: industry_relative_return_20
industry_relative_return_20.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
industry_relative_return_20.semantics: 20-day stock return minus the PIT equal-weight SW1 industry benchmark 20-day return (target excluded).

industry_relative_return_5.name: industry_relative_return_5
industry_relative_return_5.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
industry_relative_return_5.semantics: 5-day stock return minus the PIT equal-weight SW1 industry benchmark 5-day return (target excluded).

momentum.name: momentum
momentum.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
momentum.semantics: 20-day close-to-close total return of the stock (closes[-1]/closes[-21]-1).

trend.name: trend
trend.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
trend.semantics: Latest close relative to the 20-day simple moving average (close/SMA-1).

volatility.name: volatility
volatility.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
volatility.semantics: Annualized standard deviation of 20-day log returns (pstdev * sqrt(252)).

volume_ratio.name: volume_ratio
volume_ratio.pit_authority: P14-D (available_time <= as_of) via local_pipeline decision-time visibility
volume_ratio.semantics: Latest daily volume relative to the prior 20-day mean volume (volume/mean-1).
